messages: Nora Blake: Quick PSA: after switching to Docusaurus a bunch of in-page links to headings are landing at top of page instead of the section. Found on guides and tutorials. Theo Ramirez: Yep, same. CI link-checker flags unresolved anchors. Looks like docusaurus slugify removes parentheses and converts '+' to 'plus' in some cases. docs-bot: docs-ci/link-checker job #1003 1 failed: 5 unresolved anchors detected. Nora Blake: Short-term fix idea: add fallback anchors for the most-viewed pages. Longer-term: run a mapping pass or write a remark plugin to emit alias ids. Theo Ramirez: I can do the hotfix PR for top 10 pages (llm-ops, quickstart, api). Will include a tiny script to detect mismatches. Infra Squad: If you opt for a remark plugin we need to add it to the docs Docker image and include a test in the build matrix. Infra can help with that. Nora Blake: Great. Theo, please tag me in the PR and post deploy-preview when ready. Also adding a CONTRIBUTING note to avoid emoji/punctuation in H1/H2 moving forward.
